scope: Independent integrator rerun of isolated EVM feasibility probe; no operating-system worker killed and no sponsor writes or public deployment.
source_review_notes: Protected payment and publication paths both check current worker, expected epoch and deadline.
Owner can introduce a duplicate business obligation under a different step ID; worker cannot. No global semantic invoice deduplication is established.
Receipt commitment authenticates a current publisher and opaque evidence hash, not correctness/availability. An authorized worker can publish meaningless evidence first.
Enrollment cannot be individually revoked in this small probe. Whole-job cancellation blocks unpaid effects, while paid receipt recovery remains permitted.
Ordinary exact-transfer local token only; no general token admission or security audit.
